usage: 蛋卷 (daan6 gyun2) is a noun used to refer to a type of food, specifically egg rolls.
You can use 蛋卷 with measure words like '一隻蛋卷' (jat1 zek3 daan6 gyun2) to say 'one egg roll'.
When ordering food, it's common to simply say '我想食蛋卷' (ngo5 soeng2 sik6 daan6 gyun2) meaning 'I want to eat egg rolls'.
The word 蛋卷 can also be used in plural or singular form without changing, just like English egg roll.
You can describe 蛋卷 by adding adjectives before it, e.g. '香脆蛋卷' (hoeng1 ceoi3 daan6 gyun2) means 'crispy egg roll'.
